## Overview

`LineEditOperations.hpp` provides Qt-free helpers for in-place line geometry edits in the Media Viewer.

## API

| Function / type | Purpose |
|-----------------|---------|
| `LineSmoothAlgorithm` | `MovingAverage` or `PolynomialFit` local smoothing mode |
| `LineSmoothBrushParams` | Brush center, radius, algorithm, polynomial order, and strength |
| `applyPolynomialFitToLine` | Fit and resample an entire `Line2D` with a parametric polynomial |
| `smoothPolylineLocally` | Smooth only the vertex subrange inside a circular brush |

## Local Smoothing Behavior

`smoothPolylineLocally` selects vertices within `radius_px` of `center`, expands to the contiguous index range `[begin, end]`, applies the chosen algorithm to that subrange, and splices the result back into the parent line.

- **Moving Average:** runs `CoreGeometry::smooth_line` on the subrange for `strength` passes (1–3).
- **Polynomial Fit:** runs `applyPolynomialFitToLine` on the subrange and may change local vertex count.

## Related Code

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| `MediaLine_Widget::_smoothPointsInLine` | Applies brush smoothing to the selected line entity |
| `SmoothToolOptions_Widget` | Exposes brush radius, algorithm, strength, and polynomial order |
| `Media_Widget::_syncBrushHoverCircle` | Shows the shared hover circle for Eraser and Smooth tools |

See also [Smooth Tool Options Widget](SmoothToolOptions_Widget.qmd) and [Line Draw Operations](LineDrawOperations.qmd).
